name: Stendel's Pond
summary: At Stendel's Pond, anglers still come for fresh fish despite the gnolls along its banks.

sections.title: A Dangerous Watering Hole
sections.body: Southwest of Sentinel Hill, Stendel's Pond still draws anglers. Gnolls roam the muddy banks, where scattered skeletons and two lone graves mark a perilous shore. No one knows whether foul water or the beasts caused the deaths. Yet schools of sagefish still bring anglers to the pond.

faq.answer: Stendel's Pond lies southwest of Sentinel Hill in central Westfall, just off the dusty paths toward the southern reaches.

faq.q: What creatures lurk around the pond?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls prowl the pond's muddy shore and attack wanderers who approach the water.

faq.q: Why are there skeletons and graves by the shore?
faq.answer: Scattered skeletons and two unnamed graves mark the shore's dangers. The dead may have fallen to gnolls or been poisoned by the pond water, but no one knows for certain.

angles.text: Cooks value sagefish from these murky waters for their fish dishes.
Near Sentinel Hill, gnoll encampments make the pond an uncontrolled threat on the People's Militia's southern perimeter.
